description.value: Singapore Hawker is an authentic Singaporean and Malaysian hawker-style restaurant in Burnaby, run by a chef with over 25 years of experience in those cuisines. The menu spans bold dishes like roti canai, pandan leaf chicken, clay pot curries, and wok-fried noodles, with a philosophy centred on tradition and communal dining. The restaurant was recognized on DoorDash's Canada's 50 Most Loved All Stars in 2022.
